periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward-outward orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/ellipsoidal with a vertical elongation factor.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Subtle downward tapering with the inferior margin appearing broader than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band occupying approximately 40% of the visible upper-torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the dorsal cranium, roughly equivalent to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, rounded semicircular profile at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent protrusion of the lingual organ (tongue) extending beyond the oral commissure.
